thread:
incident-bot: Pager alert - High error rate (5xx) on inference API (us-east-1a) · 90% of requests hitting latency > 500ms and 12% 5xx in last 5m. Alert group: inference-us-east-1a-network.

alice_sre: Acked. I'm oncall. Investigating now — checking node health and network metrics.

alice_sre: Quick check: ASG 'rw-infer-us-east-1a' shows 8/12 nodes with network RX errors and 3 nodes in UNREACHABLE state. Cloudwatch: increased ENI drop_count for several instances.

cho_infra: Seeing elevated ENI attach/detach errors from AWS control plane in us-east-1a. Also noticing a surge in flow logs with "destination unreachable" entries. Opening AWS support case.

alice_sre: Repro: curl against inference endpoint (short) returns 502/504 intermittently. Logs show kernel-level net errors on 10.0.x.x.

dan_runtime: Pushing a quick safety change: enable canary fallback to model-variant "gpt-small-fallback" for routes tagged "high-latency" to reduce CPU/network per-request. Doing this now.

dan_runtime: Command I ran: ```
# enable fallback for high-latency policy
redwood routing set-policy --route inference.v1 --fallback-model gpt-small-fallback --threshold 400
```

alice_sre: Good. Reducing per-request load should help. Next: fail traffic away from us-east-1a where possible. We need cross-AZ routing and DNS weight shift.

chris_engineering: Suggest changing routing policy to prefer us-east-1b and us-east-1c with immediate effect. Also prep warm nodes in 1b (we have reserved capacity but need quick spin-up).

cho_infra: Kicking off ASG scale-up in us-east-1b: ```
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name rw-infer-us-east-1b --desired-capacity 20 --honor-cooldown
```  Started new instances, AMI is pre-baked.

alice_sre: I'm rebalancing load by updating the smart-router policy to prefer AZ-balanced endpoints and deprioritize hostnames in 1a. Applying now.

alice_sre: Command: ```
redwood router update --name smart-router --prefer-az us-east-1b,us-east-1c --deprioritize-az us-east-1a --max-az-skew 1
```

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-001. Severity: Sev2. Impact: some hosted API requests from US region see increased latency and intermittent errors; Dedicated customers in us-east-1a may see degraded throughput. Pager duties: alice_sre -> bob_oncall in 60m for handoff.

elaine_support: Heads up — support is seeing a small but growing set of customer tickets reporting timeouts. Posting a brief status to status.redwood.ai: "Degraded performance in US-East (single AZ) impacting inference; mitigation in progress."

maria_prod: Please include guidance for customers on how to opt into cross-region failover for critical workloads. I'll draft a short blurb for the status page now.

bob_oncall: I'm coming up to speed. @alice_sre - any known blaze points left?

alice_sre: Hey Bob — main things in flight: ASG scale-up in 1b, router policy updated to prefer other AZs, fallback model enabled for heavy routes, AWS case opened (Case 1234567890). We're also draining the most-affected hosts in 1a.

alice_sre: Drain command (started for two nodes): ```
redwood node drain --id i-0abc12345 --force --timeout 300
```

cho_infra: AWS replied on the case: "We're seeing a partial network fabric impairment affecting a subset of tenants in us-east-1a. Engineers are applying mitigation at the hypervisor/ENI layer." ETA unknown.

dan_runtime: After router change and fallbacks, p50 latency dropped from ~420ms to ~180ms for rerouted traffic. 5xx rate overall down from 12% to ~3.2% in the last 10m.

elaine_support: Posted update to status: "Mitigations in progress; traffic being routed away from affected AZ; reduced error rates observed. Customers on Dedicated instances in us-east-1a may experience degraded throughput while we reroute." :thumbsup:

alice_sre: Noting side-effects: some sticky sessions for long-running streams were interrupted during reroute. We're marking those for targeted retries client-side.

chris_engineering: For long-term resilience, we should consider adding cross-AZ sticky session token replication and shorter sticky TTLs. Raising a ticket after incident.

bob_oncall: I'll take the next shift. @alice_sre handing off: current state = mitigated (traffic preferentially out of 1a), ASG in 1b scaled to 20 desired with 6 new instances healthy, fallback active, AWS case open. Monitoring for re-intro of errors.

alice_sre: Thanks. I'll update runbook with actions taken. Handoff note in INC-2026-0315-001: mitigation steps executed and monitoring stable for 15m.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: alice_sre -> bob_oncall at 2026-03-15T03:12:00Z.

bob_oncall: Monitoring window started. If we stay <1% 5xx and p95 latency <350ms for 30m, we can start partial rollback (re-introduce some capacity to 1a) but keep fallback policy for 2 hours.

cho_infra: AWS sent another update: "Fabric mitigation ongoing; network errors reduced but not fully cleared. Please continue to shift traffic away from affected hosts."

bob_oncall: Starting controlled re-insert of healthy nodes in 1a (2 nodes) to test stability. Rolling with conservative weights.

bob_oncall: Re-introduced 2 nodes, observing metrics... slight bump in errors (0.8%) — within acceptable range.

dan_runtime: Leaving fallback model enabled but with higher threshold (500ms) to reduce unnecessary fallbacks. Command: ```
redwood routing set-policy --route inference.v1 --fallback-threshold 500
```

elaine_support: Updating status page: "Partial recovery: traffic gradually returning to us-east-1a where healthy; customers should see improved success rates. We continue to monitor."

bob_oncall: After 90m from initial alert, system stabilized: overall 5xx ~0.4%, p95 210ms. AWS marks case as "mitigation applied" and continues to monitor.

alice_sre: Root-cause pending from AWS. Capture: partial network fabric impairment in us-east-1a causing ENI drop/connect churn leading to instance-level unreachable states.

maria_prod: Noting customer impact summary for postmortem: brief window (~45m) of elevated errors for hosted API, some Dedicated customers experienced reduced throughput during traffic shift. No data loss.

chris_engineering: Adding follow-ups: (1) add cross-AZ ENI health alerts earlier, (2) add an automatic routing policy that will ramp traffic away from AZ when node-level network errors > X, (3) test runbook for fallback model enablement.

bob_oncall: Closing incident channel for real-time coordination. I'll keep monitoring for 2 more hours and then mark INC-2026-0315-001 as resolved if no regression. Great job team. :clap:

incident-bot: Incident status changed to "Monitoring".

alice_sre: Final note: prepare a short customer-facing timeline and internal postmortem draft. I'll start the internal doc and ping owners for follow-ups.

chris_engineering: Filed follow-up tickets: RW-ENG-2456 (auto-az-failover-policy), RW-PLAT-2482 (sticky-session-rework), RW-MON-2499 (eni-drop alert).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-001 will be auto-closed if no regressions by 2026-03-15T06:30:00Z.

bob_oncall: Marking thread resolved in chat. Will update the ticket when auto-close happens.
